Watch Common Ground: Orlando Edition
Sponsored by Visit Orlando
What happens when three unlikely pairs of celebrities set out to explore the city they love? Follow along as they find connection and common ground in Orlando.
Ricardo Kaká & Rafaelle Souza
Who better to take on the Orlando sports scene than these soccer legends? Watch Episode 1.
Joey Fatone & Richard Blais
A boy-band superstar and top chef sample some of Orlando’s top eats and bond over the city they love. Watch Episode 2.
Michael James Scott & The Valentine Brothers
Dive into Orlando’s arts and culture with a Broadway star and an award-winning TikTok duo. Watch Episode 3.
